description: minimumReleaseAge deliberately covers every datasource this config may grow to manage; with security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm ignored (below), it is npm's one home too

security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm is ignored because its 3-day npm rule would override the global minimumReleaseAge; its exemptions for timestamp-less npm update types (pin, replacement, rollback) are deliberately not kept: fail closed, those PRs open with a forever-pending, non-required stability status and wait for a human, as they already do for every other datasource. NOTE: an upstream rename of the preset silently re-admits it

packageRules.description: hugo-extended is intentionally pinned; updated manually via `npm run update:hugo`
Redoc 3 moves the script to bundle/redoc.js (2.x: bundles/redoc.standalone.js); the redoc shortcode hardcodes the 2.x path, so a 3.x bump is a manual migration

customManagers.description: Update the script-dependency versions pinned in the theme config
